head: Hello Dayish daily planner app plans around green, yellow or red days
dek: Hello Dayish is a new iPhone and iPad daily planner that starts by asking what kind of day you're having, green, yellow or red, and shapes the day's list around it. It was #45 among paid productivity apps on the US App Store on 14 November.
details: You dump everything on your mind, split what has to happen today from what can wait, add tasks by typing or dictating, and get one next step when you don't know where to start. A green day helps you get ahead, yellow keeps a normal day moving, and red protects only what truly has to happen. The App Store lists it at 3.99 dollars, and its description also names a monthly or yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial for new users. It's made by Wilkes Venture Group and came out on 13 November.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, 3.99 dollars; the listing also names a subscription after a 7-day trial
means: If a long to-do list makes bad days worse, this planner cuts the list down to what your energy allows that day.
todo: Read the price section of the App Store listing before you buy, since it shows both a price and a subscription. You can cancel a subscription in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before it renews.
thumb_words: A PLANNER FOR BAD DAYS TOO
